features.title: Lean back, breathe easy
features.text: Our high backrest hugs your entire body, easing tension from neck to spine—because full support should be a given.

features.title: Our armrests are shaped for real comfort
features.text: The broad, rounded design supports your arms at just the right height—reducing shoulder strain and making every sit feel naturally relaxed.

features.title: Our waterfall edge brings soft elegance
features.text: The gentle curve of the waterfall seat edge adds a refined touch while enhancing visual flow—and beneath it, slab stock foam ensures every sit feels plush and supportive.

features.title: Cleaning, made simpler
features.text: Elevated PVC legs ensure easy access underneath that makes cleaning a breeze—because comfort should come with convenience.

features.title: Built to last through life
features.text: Crafted with a sturdy pinewood frame and polyester fabric that stays cool, this piece brings comfort you can count on.
